_about: Subjects for each game's icon, painted with fal (fal-ai/nano-banana-2) using STYLE below. dev/make-icons.py turns each painting into the game's icons/ (manifest, apple-touch, favicon).
style: A polished mobile game app icon. Square, full-bleed, no rounded corners, no border, no frame, no text, no letters, no numbers. One bold, centered subject with a strong clear silhouette, filling the middle 70% of the frame, on a simple rich background that reaches every edge. Painterly 3D-rendered cartoon style with soft rim light, glossy highlights and high contrast, so it still reads at 32 pixels. Subject: {subject}. Background: {background}.
